title: Irreducibility of Generalised Laguerre Polynomials for Large Integer Parameters
summary: For a positive integer $n$, we study the irreducibility of the generalised Laguerre polynomials \[ L_n^{(a)}(x) = \frac{1}{n!}\sum_{j=0}^{n} \binom{n}{j} \frac{(n+a)!}{(j+a)!}(-1)^j x^j, \] where $a \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$. Earlier works established that these polynomials are irreducible over $\mathbb{Q}$ for $0 \le a \le 50$. In this paper, we substantially strengthen these results by establishing that $L_n^{(a)}(x)$ are irreducible for all $a \le 1000$.
